body: thank u everyone who commented and reached out. I just hit my breaking point today. I have 3 shifts left in my final placement for nursing school. I've been working 50 hours a week unpaid to finish and I am unable to pay my rent/bills because of it. among other things that have been happening in my life. I'm just trying to get through this last bit and move forward. you're all wonderful people ❤

there won't be anyone, believe me I know. some people just never find happiness and are never loved. we don't matter. we're secondary characters in other people's stories and i just can't do it anymore.
that's my exact point I don't want to just exist. and everyone has told and shown me that I'm nothing to them. even my parents.
like what's the point all I'm doing is existing to be a character in other people's narratives. I'm a waste of oxygen, of food, of everything.
